note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species, type locality Yangambi, Congo); the alate is based on only 1 female morphotype and the soldier on only 1 holotype; the original does not describe the worker. The measurements are translated verbatim from tables 13 and 14 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Compared with G. parki the alate has a narrower head, smaller and differently shaped compound eyes, a shorter pronotum with broader anterolateral corners and a straight posterior margin; compared with G. ignotus the head is slightly shorter and narrower and the wings shorter and narrower, with the lateral margins of the pronotum less convex. Compared with G. sinomalatus the soldier has a larger head, mandibles whose outer edge is not undulate, and a narrower concavity of the anterior pronotal margin; compared with G. ignotus the head is shorter and narrower, the mandibles without a distinct basal swelling, and the pronotum narrower with a concave anterior margin and less rounded posterolateral margins; compared with G. parvulus the frontal slope is gentler, the anterolateral corners of the frons less distinct, and the posterior edge of the second marginal tooth of the left mandible together with the anterior edge of the third forms a broadly concave cutting edge (rather than an angular one).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head smoky brown, paler anteriorly, light brown below the antennal sockets and around the base of the mandibles; pronotum concolorous with the anterior part of the head; antennae brown, the tip of each segment whitish; labrum pale yellow; tibiae pale yellow; femora brown; tergites dark smoky brown; sternites paler; wing scale smoky brown, the wing membrane paler than the scale. Head and body with a moderate number of long and short setae. Head behind the compound eyes broadly U-shaped. Y suture faintly visible. Ocelli oval, touching the compound eyes, slightly pointed. Antennae 12-segmented, the third segment equal to or slightly longer than the second, the fourth shorter than the second or third. Pronotum narrower than the head; anterior margin concave; lateral margins rounded; posterior margin straight. Measurements (mm; single female morphotype): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.05; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.83; head width 0.83; compound eye diameter 0.25; distance below the compound eye 0.13; ocellus length 0.07; pronotum median length 0.49, width 0.79; hind tibia length 0.64; forewing length (from the suture) 4.50, width 1.28.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown, dark brown anteriorly; mandibles reddish brown at the base, nearly black at the tip; pronotum brown with yellow patches; antennae, labrum, legs and tergites brownish. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margin and disc with long and short setae. Head long, wider posteriorly; the middle of the frons slightly concave; anterodorsal swellings indistinct; frontal slope about 45° in lateral view. Labrum with the sides converging forwards, the anterior margin rounded. Mandibles short, the outer edge evenly curved; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the posterior edge of the second together with the anterior edge of the third forming a broadly concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum narrowing forwards from its widest part. Antennae 10—11-segmented, the second segment longer than the third or fourth, the third longer than the fourth. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin forming a deep angle; lateral margins slightly straight; posterior margin concave. Femora slender. Measurements (mm; holotype soldier): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.39; head width 0.92; head height 0.83; left mandible length 0.64; maximum postmentum width 0.36, minimum width 0.15, length 0.98; pronotum median length 0.45, maximum length 0.53, width 0.83; hind tibia length 0.64.
